findings.title: NVD CVE-2026-11724: IBM MQ Managed File Transfer arbitrary code execution
findings.summary_md: IBM MQ Managed File Transfer could allow an authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on an MFT agent host because metadata used during script execution is improperly validated. Affected releases include 9.2.0.0 through 9.2.0.44 LTS, 9.3.0.0 through 9.3.0.42 LTS, 9.4.0.0 through 9.4.0.26 LTS and 9.4.5.1 CD, and 10.0.0.0 through 10.0.0.5 LTS and CD. NVD scores the vulnerability CVSS 8.5 with network access and high impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

findings.title: NVD CVE-2026-17493: IBM Watson Speech Services Cartridge denial of service
findings.summary_md: IBM Watson Speech Services Cartridge versions 4.0.0 through 5.4.0 could allow a remote attacker to cause a denial of service due to an out-of-bounds read. The flaw is reachable remotely and NVD scores it CVSS 7.5 with high availability impact.

findings.title: NVD CVE-2026-123218: IBM Aspera Faspex incorrect authorization
findings.summary_md: IBM Aspera Faspex 5.0.0 through 5.0.19 could allow an authorized user to craft a specific message to bypass user authorization and gain full administrative privileges. NVD scores the vulnerability CVSS 9.8 with network access, low attack complexity, and no privileges or user interaction required.
